QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\", \n               num_points, threshold);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n    printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Generate synthetic data\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    \n    // Perform QT clustering\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold);\n    \n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n    \n    printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n    printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n    \n    // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n    int total_clustered = 0;\n    int max_cluster_size = 0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n        const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n        total_clustered += size;\n        max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n    }\n    \n    const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 : \n        static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n    \n    printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\", \n           total_clustered, num_points, \n           100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n    printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n    printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n    \n    // Performance metrics\n    const double time_sec = cluster_time.count() / 1000.0;\n    const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n    const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\", \n           clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        // Serialize cluster membership for hashing\n        std::vector<double> membershipData;\n        membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n        std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n        for           const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return Then I'm writing the main loop that processes unclustered points in batches, uploading clustered state and seed indices to the device and launching the growth kernel to find the best cluster candidate.\n\nAfter the kernel runs, I pull back cardinalities to find the batch's local best, then compare to the global best with strict greater-than so ties resolve in favor of the first-found seed, copying over the winning cluster's members immediately so they aren't clobbered by the next batch.\n\nIf a valid best seed is found, I build the cluster from those host-side member indices, mark them clustered, and stably remove them from the unclustered list before continuing the loop.\n\nI'm checking that on the first iteration the clustered flags upload as zeros, and confirming cudaMemcpy's implicit synchronization is sufficient, though I should still check for kernel launch errors explicitly. I'm also considering whether double-buffering across batches could let me overlap transfers with kernel execution for better pipelining.\n\nMulti-stream overlap probably isn't worth the complexity since the kernel dominates runtime, though late-stage iterations with few remaining seeds leave the GPU underutilized -- that's an acceptable tradeoff since total outer iterations stay small. I'm also sanity-checking the edge case of N=1, making sure a lone seed with infinite distance still resolves correctly.\n\nFor infinity handling in device code, I need to be careful: std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity() requires relaxed constexpr flags in nvcc, so I should just use the INFINITY macro from math.h, which CUDA defines natively for device use.\n\nFor the host side I'll use INT_MAX from climits, and for comparing distances on the device I'll use fmax with the infinity sentinel to track the maximum.\n\nChecking the max-distance computation matches the original's std::max logic exactly, and verifying the candidate selection excludes already-clustered members the same way the original's findClosestPoint does when growing the member set from the seed.\n\nI want to preserve a copy of the original source before making changes, so I'll stash it in a temp directory rather than creating new files in the repo, then build baseline outputs across several configs to compare against.\n\n","time":{"start":1793027552334,"end":1793027640574},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"signature":""}}}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793027852203,"sessionID":"ses_e873ae553ffeoj2s9uAeiLmEhJ","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01Tudf996qo28YinsGznpntA","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/qtclustering_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r3/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - CUDA GPU-Parallel Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy:\n//   * Every candidate seed of a round grows its candidate cluster in its own\n//     CUDA thread block. Seeds are processed in memory-bounded batches.\n//   * Inside a block, the threads cooperatively scan all candidate points.\n//     For each candidate the maximum distance to the current cluster members\n//     (its \"diameter increase\") is maintained incrementally: adding a member\n//     only requires one new distance per candidate. Because max() is exact,\n//     this yields the same values as recomputing the max over all members.\n//   * The closest candidate is selected with a block-wide argmin on the key\n//     (distance, point index), which reproduces the sequential tie-breaking\n//     (first strictly smaller value wins, i.e. lowest index among equals).\n//   * The best seed across batches is chosen on the host with a strict '>'\n//     in the original seed order, matching the sequential semantics.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                              \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                              \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,    \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                  \\\n            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                                 \\\n        }                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Threads per block for the cluster-growing kernel (multiple of 32)\nstatic const int BLOCK_THREADS = 256;\nstatic const int MAX_WARPS = BLOCK_THREADS / 32;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points (host reference, used by validation)\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Device distance. Evaluates exactly sqrt(fma(dx, dx, round(dy*dy))), which is\n// the contraction the host compiler applies to the expression above, so that\n// GPU distances are bit-identical to the sequential reference.\n__device__ __forceinline__ double deviceDistance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    const double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    const double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return __dsqrt_rn(__fma_rn(dx, dx, __dmul_rn(dy, dy)));\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ double deviceInf() {\n    return __longlong_as_double(0x7FF0000000000000LL);\n}\n\n// Keep (v, i) if it is lexicographically smaller: smaller value, or equal value and smaller index\n__device__ __forceinline__ void keepMin(double& bv, int& bi, const double v, const int i) {\n    if (v < bv || (v == bv && i < bi)) {\n        bv = v;\n        bi = i;\n    }\n}\n\n// Block-wide argmin over (value, index) pairs. Every thread receives the same\n// winning index (INT_MAX if no entry was valid). Uses double-buffered shared\n// memory selected by 'parity' so that only one barrier is needed per call.\n__device__ int blockArgMin(double v, int i, const int parity,\n                           double (*wv)[MAX_WARPS], int (*wi)[MAX_WARPS]) {\n    const unsigned full = 0xffffffffu;\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double ov = __shfl_down_sync(full, v, off);\n        const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(full, i, off);\n        keepMin(v, i, ov, oi);\n    }\n\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        wv[parity][warp] = v;\n        wi[parity][warp] = i;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const int nWarps = blockDim.x >> 5;\n    double bv = deviceInf();\n    int bi = INT_MAX;\n    for (int w = 0; w < nWarps; ++w) {\n        keepMin(bv, bi, wv[parity][w], wi[parity][w]);\n    }\n    return bi;\n}\n\n// One block per seed: grows the candidate cluster starting from seeds[blockIdx.x]\n// and writes its cardinality and member sequence (insertion order).\n//   maxDist[b*N + c] : running max distance from candidate c to the cluster members\n//                      (+inf for points that are already clustered or in the cluster)\n//   members[b*N + k] : k-th member of the candidate cluster for seed b\n__global__ void growCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                      const int N,\n                                      const double threshold,\n                                      const uint8_t* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                      double* __restrict__ maxDist,\n                                      int* __restrict__ members,\n                                      int* __restrict__ cardinality) {\n    __shared__ double wv[2][MAX_WARPS];\n    __shared__ int wi[2][MAX_WARPS];\n\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int stride = blockDim.x;\n    const int seed = seeds[b];\n    const double INF = deviceInf();\n\n    double* md = maxDist + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n    int* mem = members + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n\n    const Point seedPt = points[seed];\n\n    // Initialize: distance to the seed (the only member so far); excluded points get +inf\n    for (int c = tid; c < N; c += stride) {\n        md[c] = (clustered[c] || c == seed) ? INF : deviceDistance(points[c], seedPt);\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    int count = 1;\n    if (tid == 0) mem[0] = seed;\n\n    int parity = 0;\n\n    // Select the first candidate: argmin of md among values below the threshold\n    int sel;\n    {\n        double lv = INF;\n        int li = INT_MAX;\n        for (int c = tid; c < N; c += stride) {\n            const double d = md[c];\n            if (d < threshold) keepMin(lv, li, d, c);\n        }\n        sel = blockArgMin(lv, li, parity, wv, wi);\n        parity ^= 1;\n    }\n\n    while (sel != INT_MAX) {\n        if (tid == 0) mem[count] = sel;\n        ++count;\n\n        // Add 'sel' to the cluster: update each candidate's max distance, then\n        // find the next closest candidate in the same pass.\n        const Point selPt = points[sel];\n        double lv = INF;\n        int li = INT_MAX;\n        for (int c = tid; c < N; c += stride) {\n            double d = md[c];\n            if (c == sel) {\n                d = INF;  // now a member; never selectable again\n            } else if (d != INF) {\n                const double dist = deviceDistance(points[c], selPt);\n                d = (dist > d) ? dist : d;  // max(current, new distance)\n            }\n            md[c] = d;\n            if (d < threshold) keepMin(lv, li, d, c);\n        }\n        sel = blockArgMin(lv, li, parity, wv, wi);\n        parity ^= 1;\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) cardinality[b] = count;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (GPU-parallel)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N == 0) return clusters;\n\n    std::vector<uint8_t> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    std::iota(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(), 0);\n\n    // Size seed batches so that per-seed device storage (N doubles + N ints) fits\n    // comfortably in free device memory.\n    size_t freeBytes = 0, totalBytes = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeBytes, &totalBytes));\n    const size_t bytesPerSeed = static_cast<size_t>(N) * (sizeof(double) + sizeof(int));\n    size_t batchCapSz = (freeBytes / 2) / bytesPerSeed;\n    if (batchCapSz < 1) batchCapSz = 1;\n    const int batchCap = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(batchCapSz, static_cast<size_t>(N)));\n\n    Point* d_points = nullptr;\n    uint8_t* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    double* d_maxDist = nullptr;\n    int* d_members = nullptr;\n    int* d_card = nullptr;\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_points, sizeof(Point) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_clustered, sizeof(uint8_t) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_seeds, sizeof(int) * batchCap));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_maxDist, sizeof(double) * static_cast<size_t>(batchCap) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_members, sizeof(int) * static_cast<size_t>(batchCap) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_card, sizeof(int) * batchCap));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_points, points.data(), sizeof(Point) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    std::vector<int> h_card(batchCap);\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const int U = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_clustered, clustered.data(), sizeof(uint8_t) * N,\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        int {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793028491290,"sessionID":"ses_e873ae553ffeoj2s9uAeiLmEhJ","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01DS3gDn37JEHxbNpqdXmqez","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/qtclustering_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r3/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - CUDA GPU-Parallel Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy:\n//   * Every candidate seed of a round grows its candidate cluster in its own\n//     CUDA thread block. Seeds are processed in memory-bounded batches.\n//   * For each candidate point, the maximum distance to the current cluster\n//     members (its \"diameter increase\") is maintained incrementally: adding a\n//     member costs one new distance per live candidate. max() is exact, so\n//     this gives the same values as recomputing the max over all members.\n//   * A candidate whose diameter increase reaches the threshold can never be\n//     selected again (the value only grows), so it is dropped from the\n//     per-seed candidate list. The lists shrink quickly as clusters grow.\n//   * The closest candidate is selected with a block-wide argmin on the key\n//     (distance, point index), which reproduces the sequential tie-breaking\n//     (smallest distance, lowest index among equals).
